scoring_justification: The scored quantities (equilibrated lattice parameters and orientation tilt) are computed from MD trajectory analysis (RDF and dot plots); the checker cannot re-run the full MD simulation, so we compare the agent's reported values against the paper's reported values with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: hidden gold values for lattice parameters and tilt angle from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reports unit cell a=b=9.6 Å, c=9.1 Å and tilt 4±1° for the 256-molecule cluster at 100 K.
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted directly from the paper's Results section.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported numbers, traceable to the source.

outputs.description: Equilibrated unit cell parameters a, b, c for the 256-molecule cluster at 100 K.
Mean molecular orientation tilt angle relative to the tetragonal axes for the 256-molecule cluster at 100 K.

output_contract.notes: The transition temperature (210 ± 10 K), disordering temperature (240 ± 15 K), and cooling‑induced local order are not included as scored stages. The transition and disordering temperatures are strongly dependent on system size and heating protocol (as noted by the authors) and cannot be reduced to a single deterministic gold that fairly scores an independent re‑implementation. The cooled local order is qualitative and the paper provides no single numeric value suitable for exact‑match scoring. Hence the task focuses on the low‑temperature equilibrated structure (lattice parameters and tilt angle) which are the primary validatable results of the original work. Both outputs are fixed physical quantities determined by the model and protocol; they are compared to the paper’s reported values within hidden tolerances.

steps.description: Compare reported a,b,c to paper values within ±0.15 Å each; full credit if all within tolerance.
Compare reported tilt angle to paper value 4.0 ±1.5°.
